title: The Courage Lit in a Small Heart

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Tsumugi came to the haunted house where the Ghost Father is, seeking the clues of the two disappeared people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギたちは消えた二人の手がかりを求め、
ゴーストファーザーが居るお化け屋敷にやって来た。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I heard that Victor and the others said they didn't see you, but it seems that there was someone who saw the two of them with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビクターさんたちを見てないって言ってましたけど、
二人があなたと居るところを見た人がいたそうですよ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Isn't it a mistake? I don't care about the two of them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見間違いじゃないか？
　俺は二人のことなんて……

text_block_list.text: U- Ugh... Tsumugi... chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うぅ……
ツムギ……
ちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: This voice...!
text_block_list.orig_text: この声は！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Everyone... run away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな……
逃げて……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ghost Father... Has gone mad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴーストファーザーが……
おかしくなった……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Victor! Eddie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビクター！
　エディ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Damn, you woke up, huh? 
I should have just devoured your energy completely while I had the chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
目覚めやがったか。
どうせなら根こそぎ精気を喰らい尽くしておけばよかったな。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Wh-What? Ghost Father, what are you saying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
せ、
せいき？
　ゴーストファーザー、
なに言ってるの？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
I said that I should have devoured their energy.
Didn't you hear me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
精気を喰らい尽くしておけばよかった
って言ったんだよ。
聞こえなかったのか。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: The ghosts... They feast on screams...
text_block_list.orig_text: お化けが食べるのは悲鳴じゃ……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
I can't become stronger with just screams. 
No matter how long it takes, with that kind of thing, 
I'll just keep making humans squeal in delight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悲鳴じゃもう強くなれねぇんだよ。
そんなもんじゃいつまでたっても
人間をキャーキャー喜ばせるだけだ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you talking about, pal?
Isn't that what haunted houses are for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何を言ってるッス？
お化け屋敷ってそういうもんじゃないッスか。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an existence that truly instills fear. 
 Not just some cheap haunted house.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺は本当の意味で恐怖を与える存在になりてぇんだよ。
お化け屋敷なんてチンケなものじゃなくてなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: I can't believe that damn mayor... making a fool out of me when I was about to feast on the vitality of those humans during the parade!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくパレードで人間どもから
まとめて精気を喰おうとしてたのに、
あの町長の野郎……
馬鹿にしやがって！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well, I never expected the Mayor to be involved too...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まさか町長さんのことも……！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, it doesn't matter.
If I shut your mouths, it'll be fine.
So, here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
どうでもいいか。
お前らの口も封じちまえばどうとでもなる。
だからここで……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: You shall be devoured by me!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 俺に喰われろ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.orig_text: なっ！？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text:
What is it, what is it? 
There's a huge monster over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだなんだ。
でっかいお化けが居るぞ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it's some kind of show! Sounds fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かのショーかしら！
　楽しそう！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
This is not a show, you know! 
It's dangerous, so stay away!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーじゃないッスよ！
危ないから離れるッス！！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's a fun show, you know! 
For me, that is! Hahaha! Let's go, shall we!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
　楽しいショーだぞ！
俺にとっての、
だがな！
はっはっは！
　行くぞ、
それっ！

text_block_list.name: Backseat ghost
text_block_list.text: *Squeeze!*
text_block_list.orig_text: ギュイッ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Something is flying towards us!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんか飛んできたぞ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're really into it, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！
　凝ってるわね！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Run away... If it touches you... Your energy...
Will be sucked away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げろ……
そいつに触られると……
精気が……
吸われちまう……

text_block_list.name: Backseat ghost
text_block_list.text: Squeeeeeeeze!
text_block_list.orig_text: ギュイギュイッ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
What? 
What is this... my body...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
なに……
これ……
体が……

text_block_list.name: Backseat ghost
text_block_list.text: *Squeeze!*
text_block_list.orig_text: ギュイッ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I can't... stand... up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
立って……
られない……

text_block_list.name: Boy a& Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhhhn! There's a scary ghost here!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁああああんん！
怖いお化けがいるよぉぉおお！！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a delightful scream! 
As a token of gratitude, I shall devour every last bit of your little life force!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉ、
心地いい悲鳴だ！
礼としてその小さな精気、
根こそぎ喰らい尽くしてやろう！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! How brave! 
In that case, I'll drain your energy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは！
　勇ましいな！
それならお前から精気を吸い尽くしてやる！！

text_block_list.name: Backseat ghost
text_block_list.text: *Squeeze, squeeze!*
text_block_list.orig_text: ギュイギュイ！

text_block_list.name: A Girl
text_block_list.text: Onii-chan...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おにいちゃん……！！

text_block_list.name: Boy a& Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much....!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとう……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: {0}! Ugh, I'm coming to help...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！
　
くっ、
今助けに……！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Useless! That man is already long gone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは！
　無駄だ！
　その男はもうとっくに……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: W-What!? Why can you still move!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なに！？
　なぜまだ動ける！
えぇい！
　取り囲んで動きを止めろ！

text_block_list.name: Backseat ghost
text_block_list.text: *Squeeze, squeeze, squeeze!*
text_block_list.orig_text: ギュイギュイギュイ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Kishi-san!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士さん！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a truly nonsensical person...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当にでたらめな人ッス……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to him attracting their attention,
an opening has been created! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
彼がやつらを引き付けてくれたおかげで隙ができた！
　行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Damn you! Hmph!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
おのれっ！
　フン！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Is that all you've got?!
text_block_list.orig_text: その程度！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
You're quite impressive, aren't you?
But hey, your footing is a bit lacking, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなかやるじゃねぇか。
けどよぉ、
足元がお留守だぜ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: What?! Guahh!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにっ！
　ぐあっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Miss Rei!!
text_block_list.orig_text: レイ様！！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
The most troublesome one seems to be settled.
But still, you're an amazing person full of energy!
I can feel your power overflowing! Fuhahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一番面倒そうなのが片付いたな。
それにしてもすごい精気の持ち主だな！
力が漲ってくるぞ！
　ふははは！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
But, not yet. I'm still not satisfied.
Ah... There's still something bothering me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが、
まだだ。
まだ喰い足りない。
ああ……
まだ目障りなのが残ってたな。

text_block_list.name: Matthew & Hughes
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi & Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Watch out!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 危ない！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi & Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Guhh!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐはっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: From my body... power is flowing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
体から……
力が……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I... I can't move... Miss Rei...
text_block_list.orig_text:
動けない……
ッス……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsugumi...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギちゃん……！！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Matsuri...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: マツリ……！！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
It is foolish to sacrifice yourself while protecting a loser.
But now, there is no one left who can oppose me.
Now I can calmly clean up this loser...
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ちこぼれをかばって自滅するとは愚かしい。
だが、
これで俺に歯向かえるものはいなくなったな。
これでゆっくり落ちこぼれの片付けを……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
W-Why is this happening...?
This way of scaring... it's wrong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしてこんなこと……
こんな怖がらせ方……
間違ってるよ……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to think about such things. 
After all, you'll just be devoured and disappear here. Hmph!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前がそんなこと考える必要はないぞ。
どうせここで俺に喰われて消えるんだからな。
ふんっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Ah, this isn't good...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぶ、
ない……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギちゃん！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well... It's not like I'm spacing out or anything...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく……
ボーっとしてるんじゃ、
ないですよ……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Can your body still move? Impressive.
But this will be the end!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その身でまだ動くか。
大したものだな。
だが、
これでとどめ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Stop, stoop!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やめろーー！！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrrrrrrrr?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあーーーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Hughes!
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒューズさん！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ……
うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Hughes!
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒューズ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Coming to be devoured willingly, huh? 
Foolishness will not save the weaklings!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっは！
　わざわざ自分から喰われに来るとは！
落ちこぼれは浅はかで助かるな！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: I can feel my power growing stronger and stronger! With this, I can plunge all those humans into the depths of fear! I am the most fearsome monster!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんどん力が高まっているのを感じるぞ！
これなら人間どもを
まとめて恐怖のどん底に陥れられる！
俺が最恐のお化けだ！！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Don't do this!
text_block_list.orig_text: こんなことやめてよ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Why? I can become a scarier monster than that.
What's wrong with that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜだ。
より怖いお化けになれるんだぞ。
それの何がいけない。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Well, um... um...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
えっと……
えっと……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really... 
That's enough... "I just wanted to see you enjoying yourself."
You should have realized it a long time ago.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく……
そんなの……
「楽しんでる顔が見たかった」
でいいんです。
とっくに気付いてるはずです。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You said it, didn't you? To entertain, you have to start with yourself first. You all naturally understood that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ったじゃないですか。
楽しませるには、
まずは自分からって。
あなたたちは、
自然とそれが分かってたんですよ。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi-chan...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギちゃん……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Yeah... haunted houses are like that, you know...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうッス……
お化け屋敷は
そういうもんスから……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
その通り……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: You, all of you! Why are you still able to move!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
貴様ら！
　なぜまだ動ける！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: What can I say... It's all about determination, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはなんていうか……
根性、
ッスかね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Determination... I like it. It's a word I like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
根性……
いいね。
好きな言葉だ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess we can't just leave these kids alone, can we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとはまぁ、
この子たちを放ってはおけないから、
ですかね。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふふっ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: What's wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何がおかしい！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: I got it! I actually prefer making people have fun rather than scaring them! Being in a haunted house with Tsumugi and the others is so much fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボク、分かった！
怖がらせることよりも
楽しませる方が好きなんだ！
ツムギちゃんたちと一緒のお化け屋敷は楽しい！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
If you say that being a ghost is no good, 
I don't need to become a full-fledged ghost! 
No, I don't want to become one!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがお化けとしてダメだっていうなら、
ボクは一人前のお化けになんかなれなくたっていい！
ううん、
なりたくない！！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Ghost Father's way is not fun!
That's why this is wrong!
It's an easy answer even I can understand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴーストファーザーのやり方は楽しくない！
だからこんなの間違ってる！
　ボクでも分かる簡単な答えだ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! What can you do, huh? 
I'll drain every ounce of your feeble energy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん！
　貴様に何ができる！
そのちゃちな精気を吸い尽くしてくれるわ！！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: U-Uwaaaahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うわぁあああああ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Matthew!!
text_block_list.orig_text: マシューさん！！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
You really are nothing but a useless burden, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっは！
　本当に何もできないお荷物じゃないか！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
My body fatigue has disappeared. 
It seems like my drained vitality has returned.
text_block_list.orig_text:
体の怠さが消えたッス。
吸われた精気も
戻ってきたみたいッスね。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Um, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
んんぅ……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Wha- my body, it's moving...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
体が、
動く……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. It seems like everyone is safe. 
In that case...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった。
みんな無事みたいですね。
ということは……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You all have become able to move, haven't you?
text_block_list.orig_text: あなたたちも動けるようになったんですね。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Are you still feeling unwell?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたんです？
　まだ具合が悪いんですか？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
We caused trouble, so...
We can't make a haunted house anymore, right...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクたち、
迷惑かけちゃったから……
もう
お化け屋敷、
できない、
よね……

text_block_list.name: Boy a& Girl
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなことない！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: You all...
text_block_list.orig_text: キミたちは……

text_block_list.name: A Girl
text_block_list.text:
We were watching you!
You went towards that scary ghost, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たち見てたよ！
あなた、
あの怖いお化けに向かっていったでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Kid
text_block_list.text: It was so incredibly cool, man!
text_block_list.orig_text: すっげぇかっこよかったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　え？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text:
I could faintly hear it too. 
Did you do your best for our sake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
僕もうっすら聞こえてたよ。
僕たちのために
頑張ってくれたんだろ？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: But we are like the same aunt as Ghost Father...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもボクたちは
ゴーストファーザーと同じおば……

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text: A brave little boy in a slightly mysterious costume, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
少しだけ不思議な仮装をした勇敢な男の子、
じゃろ？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Town Mayor! You're safe, aren't you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
町長さん！
　無事だったんですね！

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text: For now, yes. Ugh, while we were in the middle of discussing the parade, we were suddenly attacked and I have no idea what's going on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
一応な。
まったく、
パレードの打ち合わせをしていたら
いきなり
襲われて
何がなんだか分からないまま……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: What on earth happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いったい
何があったんスか？

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing particularly strange about it.
I just said that I wanted to make this year's Halloween
parade a fun one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に
何もおかしなことはなかったよ。
ただ、
ワシは
今年のハロウィンパレードは
楽しいものにしたい、
と言っただけじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: So that's why you've incurred the wrath of the Ghost Father, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text: そこがゴーストファーザーの怒りに触れちゃったワケッスね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: It's easy to say that it's trivial... but it must have been important to him. It's a troublesome story though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しょうもない……
って言うのは簡単ですけど、
彼にとっては大切なことだったんでしょうね。
はた迷惑な話ですけど。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text: うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Ah! Are you still able to move?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！
　まだ動けるッスか！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Everyone, stay back! Now, witness the final blow...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな離れて！
　今とどめを……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待って！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Matthew? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マシュー？
　どうした？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
I-I know that Ghost Father did something really bad. 
But if Ghost Father wasn't here, we wouldn't be able to have a haunted house over here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴ、
ゴーストファーザーがすごく悪いことしたのは分かってる。
けど
ゴーストファーザーが居なきゃボクたちは
こっちでお化け屋敷もできなかった……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Um, um, so, how should I say it, could you please, help me, only with my life? B-because we, Ghost Father and I, will return to the spirit world together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
だから、
なんていうか、
命だけは、
助けてあげてくれないかな。
ボ、
ボクたち
ゴーストファーザーと一緒に
霊界に帰るから。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: I promise, I will never come here again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
二度とこっちに、
来ない、
から……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Matthew...
text_block_list.orig_text: マシューさん……

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text: There is no need for that.
text_block_list.orig_text: その必要はないよ。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text:
Halloween Park's main attraction is the haunted house. 
If that's gone, then it's the end of the business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハロウィンパークは
お化け屋敷が目玉。
それがなくなったら
商売あがったりじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose that's how it is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
まぁそうでしょうけど……

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we will settle this matter properly. Guild Master... Ghost Father will be forcibly returned to the spirit world. 
And in exchange...
text_block_list.orig_text:
無論
今回の件は
きっちり落とし前をつけてもらう。
組合長……
ゴーストファーザーは
霊界とやらに強制送還。
そして代わりに……

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text: Please lead the Halloween parade as the representative of the haunted house in the park.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミたちが
ハロウィンパレードの先陣を切ってくれ。
パークのお化け屋敷代表としてな。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: By any chance, is it still okay for us to run a haunted house in this town...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひょっとして、
ボクたち
まだこの町でお化け屋敷やってもいいの……？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Do you enjoy entertaining others? 
We've had a scary experience. 
I wonder if you can entertain us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しませることが好きなんでしょ？
私たち、怖い目に遭っちゃったの。
あなたたちが楽しませてくれるかしら？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: We'll do our best to have as much fun as possible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクたち
精一杯楽しませるよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well, because someone took a loooong break today, we couldn't have the afternoon session, you know. Just a little bit, shall we extend our business hours?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁて、
今日はどっかの誰かさんたちが
なが～い休憩を取ったせいで、
午後の部ができませんでしたね。
ほんの少しだけ、
延長営業しちゃいましょうか！

text_block_list.name: Ghosts
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: That night, in Tsumugi and the others' haunted house, instead of screams... Joyful laughter echoed throughout.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その夜、ツムギたちのお化け屋敷には
悲鳴……ではなく、楽しげな笑い声が響き渡るのであった。
